input.title: How to Improve Tax Compliance? Evidence from Population-Wide Experiments in Belgium
input.authors: Jan‐Emmanuel De Neve; Clément Imbert; Johannes Spinnewijn; Teodora Tsankova; Maarten Luts

verdicts.reasoning: Main DVs are binary compliance outcomes (probability of timely payment, probability of filing) — linear probability models on dummy outcomes; secondary outcome in TF is reported taxable income (level). No log transformation on the LHS is described. Methods include four field RCTs combined with an RDD at an enforcement threshold and causal-forest heterogeneity analysis. Robustness specs add taxpayer FE across TPR rounds — that is speculative hd_fe, but the main design is single-period per experiment so panel is no.
